trails.summary: A short high-country walk. Two stops so far.

trails.title: McKenzie River
trails.summary: Down the river, starting at the falls.
trails.story: The McKenzie runs west from Clear Lake through lava and forest toward the Willamette Valley.

trails.title: Columbia Gorge
trails.story: The Columbia River cuts through the Cascades here. Creeks fall off the Oregon cliffs in a long line of waterfalls.
